name: Milk tea + 1 tsp sugar
tip: Keep your office tea. Milk quantity changes calories; one teaspoon sugar adds about 16 kcal.
imageAlt: Illustration of Milk tea + 1 tsp sugar

name: Medium plain roti
tip: About 35 g dry whole-wheat flour per roti. Keep two at lunch; skip added ghee.

name: Daal salan
tip: Affordable protein and fiber. Take more lentils and less floating oil.

name: Lobiya salan
tip: Filling beans. Ask for less oily gravy; pair with roti and salad.

name: Chana salan
tip: Useful budget protein. Oil-heavy restaurant recipes can be higher.

name: Cooked skinless chicken
tip: Breast estimate, without oil or bones. Thigh and skin increase calories.

name: Chicken karahi
tip: Mixed meat and gravy estimate. Choose more meat, less oil; roti is separate.

name: Chicken korma
tip: Protein, with richer gravy. Moderate serving, less oily gravy and salad.

name: Chicken pulao
tip: Whole mixed dish including chicken. Choose a visible meat portion; no extra roti needed.

name: Chicken biryani
tip: Moderate plate, more chicken and salad. Oil and meat proportions vary considerably.

name: Kabuli pulao, no beef
tip: Mostly rice, oil and raisins. Add beans or meat elsewhere for protein.
imageAlt: Illustration of Kabuli pulao, no beef

name: Kabuli pulao with beef
tip: Beef adds protein. Weigh the whole dish; moderate rice and oily fat.
imageAlt: Illustration of Kabuli pulao with beef

name: Plain cooked rice
tip: Pair with beans or chicken. Cooked weight, without added oil.

name: Kachumber salad
tip: Cucumber, tomato, onion and lemon. Add to meals; salad alone is not a balanced dinner.

name: Cooked vegetables
tip: Estimate includes modest oil. Plenty of volume; add a protein food.

name: Aloo salan
tip: Fine in a measured portion. Pair with beans or chicken for protein.

name: Whole milk
tip: Optional, including at night. Count it in your day; check package if available.

name: Plain yogurt
tip: Optional, not required. Unsweetened ordinary yogurt estimate.

name: Boiled egg
tip: Optional convenient protein. Not essential and no need to buy daily.

name: Roasted chana
tip: Practical snack. Dry roasted weight; measure rather than eating from the bag.

name: Apple
tip: Medium fruit. Whole fruit gives more fullness than juice.

name: Banana
tip: Medium fruit. No need to avoid bananas for fat loss.

name: Guava
tip: Fiber-rich seasonal choice. Edible weight.

name: Coal-roasted corn
tip: Medium cob, no butter. Lemon and spices add little energy.

name: Chicken soup
tip: Clear soup with actual chicken. Cornflour, cream and sparse meat change values.

name: Chicken shawarma
tip: Ask for less mayonnaise, more chicken and vegetables. Skip drink-and-fries combo.

name: Anda burger
tip: Oil and sauces matter. Ask for less sauce; counts as a meal, not a tiny snack.

name: Zinger burger
tip: Fried chicken and mayo. Enjoy occasionally; avoid adding fries and a sugary drink.

name: Pizza, regular slice
tip: Slice size varies widely. Start with two slices and salad; drinks separate.

name: Halwa puri combo
tip: Two puris, halwa and chana estimate. Share or reduce halwa; an occasional full meal.

name: Suji halwa
tip: Small portion; ghee and sugar drive calories.

name: Fruit chaat with cream
tip: Use less cream and no added sugar. Plain fruit is a lighter everyday choice.
imageAlt: Illustration of Fruit chaat with cream

name: Plain fruit chaat
tip: Without cream, syrup or sugar. Use seasonal fruit.

name: Samosa
tip: Medium fried samosa. Enjoy one occasionally, avoid automatic multiples.

name: Pakora
tip: Weigh portion. With roti it is calorie dense; add daal rather than extra pakoras.

name: Large plain naan
tip: Larger than a roti. Share or use a smaller portion; butter adds extra.

name: Paratha
tip: Oil-heavy. Occasional portion; plain roti is easier to budget.

name: French fries
tip: Small side if wanted. Easy to add many calories to an already large meal.

name: Tea biscuits
tip: Measure serving. Little protein or fullness compared with chana.

name: Potato chips
tip: Portion into a bowl; avoid grazing from the bag.

name: Sting / sugary energy drink
tip: Check bottle label. Sugar and caffeine; avoid as a daily habit, especially near bedtime.
imageAlt: Illustration of Sting / sugary energy drink

name: Regular soft drink
tip: Little fullness. Water or a zero-sugar alternative reduces drink calories.

name: Sugary slush
tip: Sugar syrup varies. Small occasional portion; water for daily hydration.

name: Black coffee
tip: Without milk or sugar. Keep caffeine away from bedtime if it affects sleep.

name: Water
tip: Everyday drink. Drink regularly; no forced excessive water target.

name: Extra oil / ghee
tip: Only log extra oil not already counted in a dish. Three teaspoons ≈120 kcal.

name: Almonds
tip: Plain edible kernels. Measure 20–30 g; nutritious but calorie dense.

name: Peanuts
tip: Budget-friendly. Shell-free weight; plain rather than sugar-coated.

name: Cashews
tip: Optional, no fat-loss advantage over cheaper peanuts. Measure serving.

name: Pumpkin seeds
tip: Hulled kernels. Useful minerals and protein but concentrated calories.

name: Walnuts
tip: Edible kernels. Small serving; not a main protein source.

name: Pistachios
tip: Shell-free weight. Choose plain or lightly salted.

name: Raisins
tip: Small measured serving. Dried fruit is concentrated compared with fresh fruit.

name: Dates
tip: Weigh or check size; large dates differ greatly from small ones.

name: Plain dry oats
tip: Dry weight before cooking. Add water or milk; skip added sugar.

name: Boiled chickpeas, drained
tip: No added oil. Use for chaat or salad.

name: Boiled lentils, plain
tip: Cooked drained lentils without added oil.

name: Choly chawal
tip: Estimate for 200 g cooked rice + 150 g chickpea curry. Choose more choly and less oily gravy; add salad. Recipe and oil can change calories substantially.

name: Dahi bally / dahi bhallay
tip: Estimate for yogurt, lentil dumplings and chutney. Ask for unsweetened yogurt and less sweet chutney; fried dumplings and toppings can raise calories.
imageAlt: Illustration of Dahi bally / dahi bhallay

name: Milk coffee + 1 tsp sugar
tip: 250 ml whole milk + instant coffee + one teaspoon sugar. Without sugar ≈155 kcal; water-diluted coffee has fewer calories. Cream or extra sugar adds calories.
imageAlt: Illustration of Milk coffee + 1 tsp sugar
